name: Windows-MCP
description: Operate the real Windows desktop: genuine mouse/keyboard input and UI Automation actions, verified after every step
long_description:
Windows-MCP connects AI agents to the real Windows desktop. Agents launch apps, click buttons, fill forms, pick list and combo-box items, press shortcuts and manage windows and files -- with genuine input, on real applications.

**KEY FEATURES**
- **Real interaction, verified**: Find locates live controls through UI Automation; Act operates them with real mouse/keyboard input first (so applications run their own handlers) and UIA patterns as fallback, then reads the control back and reports Verified / NOT verified plus the visible effects (windows opened/closed, focus changes).
- **Precise input**: SendInput with virtual-desktop absolute coordinates, atomic key chords, correct extended keys, exact Unicode text (CJK, emoji) that input methods do not intercept.
- **Stable references**: Snapshot labels and element references are re-located, scrolled into view and hit-tested before every action, so moved or covered windows are handled instead of mis-clicked.
- **Safe by default**: keyboard input only reaches a window confirmed in the foreground; critical system processes cannot be killed; telemetry is off unless enabled.
- **Fast**: scoped Snapshots, ~40 ms element searches, no startup delay.

**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS**
- **Windows 10/11, Python 3.12+**

anonymized_telemetry.title: Anonymized Telemetry
anonymized_telemetry.description: Off by default. When enabled, sends tool names, success/failure, duration and client name to the upstream PostHog project -- never tool arguments or outputs.

profile_snapshot.title: Profile Snapshot Performance
profile_snapshot.description: Enable detailed performance logging for desktop snapshots and screenshots in the server console/logs. Useful for troubleshooting latency.

screenshot_backend.title: Screenshot Backend
screenshot_backend.description: The engine used to capture screenshots. 'auto' automatically selects the fastest available backend (DXGI -> MSS -> Pillow). Use 'pillow' if you encounter capture issues.

debug.title: Debug Mode
debug.description: Enable debug mode to provide verbose logging for troubleshooting.

watchdog.title: UIA Focus WatchDog
watchdog.description: Run the UIAutomation focus watchdog that keeps the accessibility tree current. Disable if the watchdog degrades or crashes on unstable UIA environments after long uptime.

tools.name: Screenshot
tools.description: Fast screenshot with cursor position and window list; the quickest way to look at the screen.

tools.name: Snapshot
tools.description: Live UI tree of one window (window=) or the desktop; every element carries a #N label usable in Click/Type/Act. Optional screenshot, browser DOM mode and word-level nodes.

tools.name: Find
tools.description: Search a real window for controls by name / control type / automation id; returns references (e1 ...) with coordinates, supported actions and current state.

tools.name: Act
tools.description: Operate a real control (click, toggle, select item, expand, set/append text, set slider, invoke, focus) with real input first and UIA as fallback (via=auto|input|uia); reads the control back and reports the effects.

tools.name: Click
tools.description: Real mouse click at [x, y] or on a Snapshot label (re-located and hit-tested live); left/right/middle, 0-3 clicks; reports the element hit and the effects.

tools.name: Type
tools.description: Click a field, confirm its window holds the keyboard, type exact Unicode text (clear / press_enter / caret_position / method), then read the field back.

tools.name: Scroll
tools.description: Real mouse-wheel scrolling (vertical or horizontal) at a point or label; reports the scroll position before/after.

tools.name: Move
tools.description: Glide the pointer to [x, y] or a label, or drag-and-drop (drag=True, optional from_loc and duration).

tools.name: Shortcut
tools.description: Atomic keyboard shortcuts and chord sequences ("ctrl+s", "ctrl+k ctrl+s"), optional repeat and target window; reports the effects.

tools.name: Wait
tools.description: Pause for a number of seconds.

tools.name: WaitFor
tools.description: Poll until text, a window, an element or a focused element appears.

tools.name: App
tools.description: Launch apps (waits for and reports the new window), launch an exact executable, switch (verified), resize, minimize, maximize, restore or close windows (by name or handle).

tools.name: MultiSelect
tools.description: Select several items with Ctrl held (always released), by coordinates or labels.

tools.name: MultiEdit
tools.description: Fill several input fields at once, by coordinates or labels.

tools.name: Clipboard
tools.description: Read or set the clipboard text.

tools.name: PowerShell
tools.description: Execute PowerShell commands.

tools.name: FileSystem
tools.description: Read, write, copy, move, delete, list, search and inspect files and directories.

tools.name: Registry
tools.description: Read, write, delete and list Windows Registry values and keys.

tools.name: Process
tools.description: List processes or terminate them by PID or name; critical system processes and the server itself are protected.

tools.name: Notification
tools.description: Send a Windows toast notification.

tools.name: DisplayInventory
tools.description: Display layout, work areas, effective DPI and scale.

tools.name: Scrape
tools.description: Fetch a web page, or read the active browser tab's DOM text.
